evidence.description: src/App.test.tsx 'shows an empty, labelled Search input in the filter controls row (search AC1)' and 'reaches the Search input by keyboard after the other controls (search AC1)' passed. They check the empty textbox named Search in the same .controls row as Status, all 12 tasks listed, and Tab from Starred only focusing Search.

Unit tests 'matches the title case-insensitively and ignores surrounding spaces', 'matches the title only, not the description' and 'keeps inner spaces in the search text' (src/domain/filter.test.ts), plus component test 'filters by title as the user types, ignoring case and surrounding spaces (search AC2)', all passed. The e2e step '  ROTA ' in 'searches tasks by title alongside the other filters' was written but not run locally.

Unit test 'combines search with status and starredOnly' (also checks the input is not mutated) and component test 'combines Search with Status and Starred only (search AC3)' passed. The e2e Search + Status 'To do' step was written but not run locally.

Component test 'counts only tasks the search leaves visible, keeping total and starred counts (search AC4)' passed: the aria-live=polite line reads 'Showing 1 of 12 tasks · 1 starred'. The e2e 'Showing 1 of 12 tasks' assertion was written but not run locally.

Component test 'shows the existing empty message and a zero count when the search matches nothing (search AC5)' passed. It covers search-only no-match ('zzz') and combined no-match ('rota' + To do), showing role=status 'No tasks match the current filter.' and 'Showing 0 of 12 tasks'.

Unit test 'does not filter when the search is empty or only spaces' and component test 'restores the tasks allowed by the other filters when Search is cleared or blank (search AC6)' passed. With Status Done, clearing returns 3 items and 'Showing 3 of 12 tasks', and a blank search still shows 3. The e2e clear step back to 12 items was written but not run locally.

reason: Added a 'Search' text input to the filter controls row. The list now shows only tasks whose title contains the search text, matched case-insensitively with leading and trailing spaces trimmed, and the search combines with the Status and Starred only filters. I followed the approved plan without deviation: TaskQuery gains an optional `search` field, filterTasks applies the title clause, and App holds the search in non-persisted state. Unit, component and e2e tests were added for AC1-AC6. Lint, typecheck, unit tests and build pass locally; the e2e test was written but not run here (left to coordinator checks).
